group.passage:
The Lost City at Sun City in South Africa is a fascinating destination to visit. Legend has it that centuries ago, an African tribe brought with them their rich heritage and settled in an ancient volcanic crater which they called the Valley of the Sun. [[1]] Unfortunately, a devastating earthquake turned the city into ruins, forcing the residents to flee from their homes. Today, the city has been restored to its past glory and named The Lost City.
The centerpiece of the Lost City is the Palace, a truly magnificent hotel which boasts unsurpassed five-star luxury as well as overlooks 25 hectares of jungle and the Valley of Waves, a water adventure park. [[2]] Here players may get to see live crocodiles enjoying their haven under the sun at the 13th hole.
The Valley of Waves is Sun City’s legendary hub for all kinds of water fun. It features a Lazy River Ride, a non-stop tube ride around an island for whoever wants to relax. [[3]] Visitors are challenged to experience an adrenaline-inducing 17-meter drop down a 70-meter slide into a pool.
Animal and nature enthusiasts would never miss going into the game parks of South Africa. The Pilanesberg National Park is just a stone’s throw from Sun City. It covers over 60,000 hectares of bushland and sustains an interesting wildlife population. Visitors either ride on horses or take a safari jeep to explore the park. [[4]] A safari drive is considered successful when the Big Five, i.e. the lion, leopard, rhinoceros, buffalo and elephant are sighted.

options_bank.A: Behind the hotel is a golf course which stretches across the ochre bushveld.
options_bank.B: Not for the faint-hearted is the Temple of Courage.
options_bank.C: Guides are provided to assist them.
options_bank.D: The people built a splendid city of unique architectural design.
